test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3430fb49e322d9022eec897eac41194189ffcc776842e56f2878ecb018b45406.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The 1st column elements shift anticlockwise in the downward direction.

The rest of the element shift anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aeb950b421d23b56df6d9240d30d177483bdf61ab0d0142fc63528ba96c5d962.png] 

2) Second box series → 

The 3rd column elements shift clockwise in the downward direction.

The rest of the element shift clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bd1e66a583e40d7a5e074f1c221d6c19888f419df4a120012205bed424bdd45.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11b606724d15fef8f4000e8343c8b0630ae7a5fd161980c82159768405da0047.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
